title: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter
responsibility: Execute exact-model Claude Code or Codex CLI module tasks, exposing public results and structured quota rejection without transporting provider keys.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.constructor.execute
inputs.description: Optional process executor for CLI calls; when omitted, the adapter uses taskProcess to launch the selected provider command.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.command.selection
inputs.description: Provider, exact model and intelligence level used to build that provider's CLI argument vector.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Provider selection plus the task working directory, prompt and abort signal needed to execute and cancel one CLI run.

inputs.name: taskProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable and argument strings for the selected provider CLI, launched as one admitted task process.

inputs.name: taskProcess.input
inputs.description: Run context supplying the selected provider and model, child working directory, prompt for stdin and signal for cancellation.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.command
outputs.description: Argument vector for the selected provider CLI, including its model, effort and output settings.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.run
outputs.description: Resolves to the selected task identity, public response text and reported model after CLI events pass success and identity checks.

outputs.name: taskProcess
outputs.description: Resolves with the child CLI exit code and captured stdout after the admitted process closes; stderr is discarded.

errors.name: ModuleTaskRunError
errors.description: Signals a failed provider run, quota rejection, denied tool permission or a CLI model different from the requested selection.
